etsy.title: Git Commit Poster, Friday 4:59 PM wip Joke, Funny Coding Wall Art, Office Humor Print, Gift for Programmers
etsy.description:
A funny git commit poster for every Friday 4:59 PM 'wip' commit, in dark-mode colors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy git posters lean on the 'in case of fire: git commit, git push' sign and mock terminal commit messages.
Friday-deploy jokes show up on mugs and shirts rather than posters, so the 4:59 PM angle is distinct.
Framed git prints run about $50-60; cheat sheets are cheap digital downloads.

searchPhrases: in case of fire git commit
competitorNotes: The one git poster on Amazon is the 'in case of fire' joke as a 13x13 print, sold as tech room decor.
Amazon programmer prints lead with the joke, then stack 'wall art', 'office decor', 'developer gift' and state 'unframed' plus size.

research.notes: 'git commit poster' matches an Etsy listing title and the search; 'git poster' is left for tags so git-stash can lead with it. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with framed prints, and no unframed physical prints with prices were comparable.
